# Circana and Ode plan expert checks for market-intelligence agents


By OpenTools Team


Reference‑case checks and specialist handoffs are announced, with results and case studies to be shared later.


##


Checks and handoffs


According to an[October 29 announcement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/29/3391364/0/en/circana-puts-ai-to-work-engages-ode-with-anthropic-to-build-a-faster-smarter-market-intelligence-engine.html) , Circana and Ode are building an agent platform with checks against expert‑verified cases and routing of uncertain work to Circana specialists.


##


Ownership before results


The initial areas are data processing, trend forecasting and product classification. Operators would own goals and quality.


A reference‑case check and a live handoff answer different questions: performance on the chosen examples, and which work needs specialist judgment. Circana says it will share results and case studies as the work scales.


Original announced‑workflow map: agents are checked against expert‑verified cases; uncertain work is routed to Circana specialists. No operating results are depicted.
